source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.1 (PDF 127, printed 124).

blocks.text: Model building ka matlab hai kisi complex (uljhe hue) masle ki ek simplified representation (saada shakal) banana. Is mein sirf key elements (aham hisson) par focus (dhyan) kiya jata hai. Is se asal zindagi ke problems (masle) ko samajhna, analyze karna (jaanchna) aur hal karna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Model kya chhor deta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Model unnecessary details (faltu baatein) chhor deta hai, ta ke dhyan masle ke sab se aham hisson par rahe.

items: Model building: complex masle ki saada shakal banana jis mein sirf aham hisse rakhe jate hain.
